{{< include _sk/settings.html >}}

## Appearance and Fonts {.i-palette}

Appearance follows the system or pins light or dark, and the accent is
one of seven: periwinkle, orchid, rose, amber, moss, jade or teal. Fonts
has eight faces for the chat and four monospace faces for code
and the terminal, all under the Open Font License, and one text size for
all three.

## New sessions {.i-sparkles}

Each agent's mode, model and effort to begin with. The pills under the
composer change them for one session.

## Composer, Terminal, Files {.i-settings}

Each one's own switches: which key sends and which languages are
spell-checked; the terminal's scheme, its cursor, and whether a selection
copies itself; format on save and its formatters.

## Updates and About {.i-refresh}

Updates checks daily, or now, and installs the new version itself. About
says which version this is and who makes it.
